q: How should we answer the BRSR question on projects to reduce greenhouse gas emissions?
title: BRSR question on GHG reduction projects
short: Principle 6 essential indicator 7 asks whether the company has any project to reduce GHG emissions and, if yes, for details. Give each project with its site, what changed, the year, and the tonnes CO2 saved, calculated from metered energy or fuel before and after.
audience: Listed companies and plant heads preparing BRSR

p: Does the entity have any project related to reducing Green House Gas emission? If Yes, then provide details.

ul: Project and site: for example, 400 kWp rooftop solar at the Pune plant.
Measured effect: kWh generated or fuel saved in the year, from meters or bills.
Tonnes CO2 avoided, with the factor and its source.
Whether it is reflected in this year's Scope 1 or 2 figures.

p: A reduction claimed here should show up in your energy and emissions tables. If emissions rose overall because output rose, say so and give intensity per unit of output alongside.

senseible: Senseible reads kWh, litres and kg from electricity bills and fuel invoices into a dated record per site, with the factor and source on every line, and prepares BRSR drafts from that data. Reports are self-declared drafts.
